description: This file defines the main entry point for the Calculator application using SwiftUI. It sets up the app's main scene with a CalculatorScreenView as the initial view.

classes.name: CalculatorApp
classes.description: The main application struct conforming to the App protocol, responsible for launching the application with its initial scene.

methods.name: body
methods.description: A computed property that defines the main scene of the application, which contains a window group displaying the CalculatorScreenView.
